name: Oman

income_tax.summary: Scored on the law in force for 2026: Oman levies no personal income tax in 2026. A personal income tax takes effect on 1 January 2028 (5% on annual income above OMR 42,000 after eligible deductions, worldwide income for residents), so it does not enter the 2026 scoring. Only Omani employees pay social insurance (8%); no expat employee contribution is listed.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: No self-employment contributions apply to expatriates in the sources found. From 2028, residents including expatriates are taxed at 5% above OMR 42,000 a year.
income_tax.local_tax_note: No local income-based taxes. For Omani employees, retirement contributions use a subscription wage ceiling (initially OMR 3,000).

sources.title: Oman - Individual - Taxes on personal income (last reviewed 7 Jul 2026)

open_questions: PIT effective 1 Jan 2028 is not in the 2026 brackets by design; PwC does not name the law (the existing jurisdiction file cites Royal Decree 56/2025).
Self-employed social security not covered by PwC.

PwC other-taxes page re-opened 2026-10-15: Omani employees 8% (7.5% retirement + 0.5% job security), expatriates no employee contribution (employer 3%); no self-employed rate listed (0% is a reading of silence).

residence_routes: EU, US and other citizens: no visa-free right to work. Skilled employees obtain a work visa and residence through an Omani employer. A travel-cost site (not opened) states Oman has no dedicated digital-nomad visa; this was not confirmed from an official source.
open_questions: Digital-nomad visa status not verified from an official source.
